subject: an English Tudor queen with pale skin and curled red-gold hair, a high white lace ruff, a richly embroidered dark velvet gown with strings of pearls, composed and watchful expression

panels.01-greenwich: a Tudor royal palace of red brick beside the wide River Thames at Greenwich in 1533, sailing barges on the water, autumn morning light, wide establishing shot, 16th century England
panels.02-study: a red-haired Tudor girl of about eleven in a simple dark gown sitting at a wooden desk by a leaded window, writing carefully with a quill in a small handmade book, open Latin and French books beside her, an embroidered book cover on the table, 1540s England
panels.03-tower: a young red-haired Tudor woman of twenty in a plain dark cloak standing in the rain on stone steps at the water gate of the Tower of London in 1554, guards with halberds nearby, grey sky, dignified and defiant, not violent
panels.04-accession: a young {S} aged twenty-five standing in a wood-panelled hall of the old royal palace at Hatfield in November 1558, courtiers in Tudor doublets kneeling respectfully before her, quiet resolve
panels.05-coronation: a young {S} in gold coronation robes and an ermine mantle seated on a throne inside Westminster Abbey in January 1559, holding orb and sceptre, crowds of nobles and bishops, candlelight and stone arches
panels.06-armada: tall wooden sailing ships of the Spanish fleet scattered by a great storm and dark waves in the English Channel in 1588, small burning fireships drifting in the distance at night, dramatic sky, no people visible, no blood
panels.07-tilbury: {S} in her fifties in a white gown, riding a white horse among ranks of English soldiers with pikes and banners at the Tilbury camp in Essex in August 1588, holding a commander's baton, speaking to the troops, inspiring and calm
panels.08-golden: an older {S} with grey-gold hair and a jewelled ruff standing before a crowded panelled council chamber of kneeling members of Parliament in black gowns in 1601, warm candlelight, a farewell speech, dignified and moving
